workPackages.title: Pipeline: project file, cached pure stages, CLI, job-folder protocol and isolated launcher contract
workPackages.spec:
Implements DESIGN 2.4 data flow, 3.2 project/result/job formats, D-10 (never silent flips), D-24 (launcher contract), D-25 (cache TTL), invariants 3-4. pipeline/__init__.py: """face3d.pipeline: project, stages, jobs and CLI (exports added by WP-23)."""

project.py: @dataclass Project mirroring the DESIGN 3.2 JSON (format 'face3d.project' v1): seed, consent_id, template {id, topology_sha256}, settings {sex_prior: 'unspecified'|'male'|'female' (optional consented input; never inferred), population: 'unknown'|'matched' (never stored as ancestry), scale_population_source}, photos (id, path, sha256, rights_basis, working_copy, exif summary, tags, include, focal_group), pins, scale_refs, decisions, active_solve, landmark_cache {keep: false}. load/save with validation; add_photo(path, rights_basis) (sha256, EXIF via io.exif or HEIF via io.heif, focal group key; no pixel decoding beyond PNG/.npy working copies supplied by callers); record_decision(kind, photo, by) (also writes an AuditLog entry).

stages.py: each stage a pure function (inputs: dict, config: dict, seed: int) -> dict, registered in STAGES with declared inputs/outputs and data_class: ingest; triage (qa.checks photo and set checks, occluder actions, focal ladder via solve.focal); landmarks (LandmarkSets and pins to per-view observations; scheme permutation; geometric L/R via model.registry.resolve_lr; expression tags); solve (multi-start PnP, bundle v2 with CompositePrior(FactorPrior default sex/population from settings, ConditionalTemplatePrior for non-anatomical scheme points), zeta, scale terms from scale_refs and iris, RobustSchedule, view weighting, soft focal tie 0.02, distance priors, jaw; then nuisances: mirror_test per view (decision cards only), expression inflation, camera-model selection; re-solve; symmetry term with evidence gating after a first pass); observe (observability, LOVO gamma, sigma_rep, ledger, tier, next-best view); fit (warp stages A-D, contours when ContourObs exist); uncertainty (per-vertex sigma_n); handoff (KeyStack arrays, optional limit-fitted cage); texture (gated; only when requested); report (result.json + arrays.npz per DESIGN 3.2 plus a plain-text report with the 'not validated against a scan' banner, tier, scale mode and +/-%, focal statuses, region claims worst-first, flags, count of active unverified defaults). run_pipeline(project, until='report', cache: StageCache, apply_mirror: set[str] = ()) runs in order, keys each stage by core.cache.StageCache.key (input hashes, config snapshot, seed, engine version), enforces core.policy.check('reconstruct') before landmarks/solve and check('texture') before texture, and applies a mirror flip only for photos with a recorded user decision or listed in apply_mirror (which records a decision with by='cli' and an audit entry). Landmark caches are BIOMETRIC_GEOMETRY with TTL 0 unless project.landmark_cache.keep.

jobs.py: write_job(job_dir, stage, inputs, config, seed); run_job(job_dir) -> exit code: reads job.json, runs the requested stages, checks the 'cancel' sentinel between stages and via a callback between LM outer iterations, appends progress.jsonl lines {t, stage, frac, msg_key}, writes result.json + arrays.npz atomically (tmp then os.replace), on exception writes error.json {code, msg_key, stage} only (no paths, arrays or coordinates; eth A7/F19) and returns non-zero; read_progress(job_dir, offset) -> (lines, new_offset).

cli.py + face3d/__main__.py: python -m face3d {triage,solve,fit,report,testbed,job} with --project PATH, --seed, --until, --apply-mirror ID (repeatable), 'job run JOB_DIR', 'testbed scorecard ...' (delegates to face3d.testbed.scorecard.main). main(argv) returns an exit code.

workPackages.title: Release gates: fault-injection matrix, honesty gates, scorecard v1 vs baseline, CI policy checks, package exports
workPackages.spec:
Integration and release gates (DESIGN 7.3-7.5, H12, section 8 conventions).
1. Exports: update every subpackage __init__.py to re-export the public APIs listed in DESIGN 2.3 (keep all existing exports working); face3d.__version__ = '0.2.0'. pyproject.toml: package data (face3d/data/*.json, face3d/schemes/*.json, face3d/core/defaults.toml), optional dependency group test = ['pytest>=7'], console script face3d = 'face3d.pipeline.cli:main', pytest marker 'slow', testpaths tests.
2. tools/ci_checks.py (callable as main() and from tests): (a) AST: no import of bpy, scipy, cv2, torch, mediapipe or PIL anywhere under face3d/; (b) NumPy 1/2 neutrality: forbid np.float_, np.in1d, np.product, np.alltrue, np.sometrue, np.Inf, np.NaN under face3d/; (c) import every face3d module, then every core.config Default has a valid badge and a non-empty source; (d) blender_ext: only bridge.py calls foreach_get/foreach_set/pixels; manifest lint; GPL SPDX header in every .py; (e) fixtures/golden files under tests/ that contain landmark or mesh data carry provenance in {synthetic, cc0, consented} (no real-person detections, eth A8); (f) a full synthetic pipeline run under core.policy.network_guard().
3. tests/test_fault_matrix.py: run every face3d.testbed.faults.FAULT_MATRIX row (DESIGN 7.4) through face3d.pipeline (solve and observe stages; surface rows also fit) with >= 30 seeds (marked slow); a 5-seed fast subset runs per push with thresholds relaxed by at most the binomial 95% interval (documented in the test). Compute TPR/FPR/degradation per row against the clean run with the same seeds. Alarm budget: 20 clean photo sets give <= 1 spurious warn/block finding per 10 clean photos.
4. tests/test_honesty_gates.py (>= 30 seeds, slow; fast subset per push): vertex coverage in measured regions 0.90-0.99 at 1.96 sigma_rep on out-of-prior surface subjects; aligned landmark 1-sigma coverage 0.60-0.76 and gauge-projected NEES/dof 0.8-1.25 with 1 mm definition bias; false confidence <= 5% of measured regions over 2x their target; labels invariant to likeness mode; scale z RMS 0.8-1.25.
5. Scorecard v1: run face3d.testbed.scorecard with the v2 engine (same scenarios and seeds as the baseline), commit tests/golden/scorecard_v1.json; assert no legacy-scenario regression beyond 2% (config RMS and likeness-weighted error) versus tests/golden/baseline_scorecard_v0.json; docs/RESULTS.md tabulates baseline vs v1 per scenario and per gate, honestly listing unmet targets with badges.
6. If a gate fails: diagnose, recalibrate only registered defaults within their bounds (core.config), and record the evidence in RESULTS.md; thresholds may change only by editing the DESIGN 7.4/7.5 tables with a justification line. Never weaken a gate silently.

INTEGRATION NOTES FROM WP-15: the DESIGN 7.4 single-view targets (mirror-test TPR 0.95 at 0.8 mm asymmetry; retouch TPR 0.8) are NOT reachable at the DESIGN 4.4 nominal detector noise: measured mirror TPR ~0.44 among views with g >= 4, retouch TPR ~0.25 (WP-15 tests run at 0.2x nominal noise). g_min = 4 is inconsistent with the decision thresholds (observed gap ~3.4 x g_perp; g ~12 needed for 95% detection). The fault matrix must therefore either recalibrate g_min / pool evidence across views, or state the per-noise-level targets honestly (never weaken a gate silently: document the measured detection rates and the conditions under which the DESIGN targets hold). Honesty requirement: at nominal noise the mirror test must make no false flips and return 'undetermined' rather than a false 'keep' (WP-15 asserts <= 30% 'keep' on mirrored views).

INTEGRATION NOTES FROM WP-19/WP-16: (a) per-vertex sigma_n (face3d/fit/uncertainty.py) is honest but far too conservative in measured regions: pooled 1.96-sigma coverage 1.000, z RMS 0.14-0.32, median sigma_n ~6 mm vs ~1 mm normal error; SIGMA_RES_MM alone already covers 99.5-100 %. workPackages.title: Offline calibration programme: real CC0 template kit, two-annotator landmarks, MediaPipe render-and-detect index map (M3b) and tiers 2-4 calibration (M7)
workPackages.spec:
Requires Blender, MediaPipe with a SHA-pinned .task model, two human annotators, a 3D printer, phones and consenting sitters, plus user-supplied ANSUR II CSV and FLAME 2023 Open files. None of these exist in the sandbox, so this package is executed offline by maintainers using the tools from WP-08/WP-14 and the pipeline from WP-20.
M3b (real template and index map): (1) choose the CC0 base: Blender Studio Human Base Meshes head (CC0, verified) preferred; MPFB2 hm08 only if maintainers verify its CC0 status (single-sourced, disputed); record the upstream sha256. (2) Topology QA per open-template-head-kit: quads in deforming zones, poles >= 2 rings from lid/lip/alar loops, exact x=0 midline, 8-12k skin vertices, closed scalp, eye and mouth bags. (3) Two annotators place the 44 anatomical landmarks independently from the craniometric definitions; accept agreement <= 1.0 mm (sharp/curve) or <= 2.5 mm (extremal); sigma_annot = spread. (4) Build the kit with tools/build_template_kit.py (CC0 only, bundle_ok true) and add it to assets.toml. (5) Render 20-50 calibrated views of the template in Blender, run tools/detect_mediapipe.py on the maintainer machine, run tools/calibrate_scheme.py; commit the updated scheme semantics (verified flags, geometric iris L/R record) and an aggregate report only. If the store rejects derived index tables (ethics C7, contested), ship the calibration tool and build the map locally on first run instead.
M7 (calibration tiers): tier 2 renders of CC0 heads through a simulated phone pipeline plus MediaPipe; tier 3 a 3D-printed CC0 head photographed with >= 3 phones; tier 4 consenting sitters (1-3 growing to ~10) with a reference scan, a repeat scan as the noise floor, protocol ring, rear-phone, selfie and dated camera-roll sets, retention per ethics section 4, aggregate results only. Calibrate: noise sigma by kind and per-index detector bias (sigma_def), robust and view thresholds, mirror/expression/retouch thresholds, alarm rates, region targets; recompute scale_sigma_log and refit the factor prior from ANSUR II (balanced pooling, never ancestry-conditioned) and FLAME 2023 Open samples (with attribution) via tools/recalibrate_prior.py -> landmark_prior_v2.json; replace provisional badges by measured ones in core/defaults.toml; remove the 'not validated against a scan' banner only for configurations that passed tiers 3-4; run the six-face lineup test (target >= 80%).

workPackages.title: Follow-up fixes found during WP-15: scale-consistent symmetry/midline rows; tangent sigma for point kinds without image tangent
workPackages.spec:
Two defects found by the WP-15 implementer (see its report) in files owned by WP-07/WP-10:
1. face3d/solve/bundle.py: the legacy Priors.pairs / Priors.midline symmetry and midline residual rows act on X in physical mm, while the shape prior acts on X~ = exp(-zeta) X when the explicit log-scale zeta is enabled (WP-07/DESIGN D-03). With a weak scale (iris only, free zeta) these rows therefore pull the global scale toward smaller heads (measured: head size ~8% low in WP-15's iris-only scene). Fix: when zeta is enabled, evaluate the symmetry and midline rows on X~ (residual (X~_l - M X~_r)/sigma_sym and X~_mid,x/sigma_mid) with the correct analytic Jacobian (d/dX = e^-zeta * (...), d/dzeta = -(...)), unchanged behaviour when zeta is disabled (legacy path must stay bit-identical; existing tests must pass). Add a regression test: iris-only (or no metric cue) scene with symmetry rows on, head-size bias within the no-symmetry-rows bias +- 1%; strict per-block analytic-vs-numeric Jacobian check of the new rows.
2. face3d/solve/noise.py: point-like landmark kinds (e.g. 'extremal') whose image tangent is unknown use sigma_n only, underestimating noise along the unknown tangent (DESIGN 4.4 gives sigma_t, e.g. 3 mm for extremal). Fix: when no tangent direction is available, use an isotropic covariance with variance max(sigma_n^2, sigma_t^2) for kinds whose sigma_t is finite (curve/contour kinds whose sigma_t is 'free' keep their existing handling); document it. Add a test that the per-observation covariance for an extremal point without tangent has both eigenvalues >= sigma_t(px)^2, and that the WP-07 chi2/NEES tests still pass.
Do not change other behaviour. Run the 30-seed scorecard fast mode and report any change vs the current state.

workPackages.title: Close the H5 focal-label release blocker and the missing pipeline wiring found by the WP-23 fault matrix
workPackages.spec:
The WP-23 release run (docs/RESULTS.md sections 3 and 3.1; tests/test_fault_matrix.py CALIBRATION_PENDING / OPEN_HONESTY_VIOLATIONS) blocks the release on one failing honesty gate and lists pipeline wiring that the engine already supports but the pipeline never calls. Fix them, re-run the 30-seed release matrix (python3 -m pytest -q -m slow) and update RESULTS.md and the gate lists honestly (move a gate out of CALIBRATION_PENDING / OPEN_HONESTY_VIOLATIONS only when it passes on the 30-seed point estimate).
Tasks:
1. RELEASE BLOCKER exif_crop.focal_label (H5/H12): with a +/-30 % wrong (cropped) EXIF focal, all 150 views are labelled focal 'measured' while 28 % off, because sigma_post(ln f) < 0.10 is inherited from the EXIF prior (sigma_log 0.04). In solve/observability.camera_status label 'measured' only from the information the photos carry: e.g. the posterior sigma of ln f computed with the focal prior removed (flat prior: drop the prior's information from the Schur-complemented focal block) or demote when the CAM-7 prior_dominated test is true. Then emit the DESIGN 4.13 focal-vs-EXIF disagreement finding (solved focal differs from EXIF by > 15 % with data information to say so) and the C-FOCAL-PRIOR finding (exif_unobservable.c_focal_prior: raise it in the observe stage when the focal label is not 'measured'). Keep exif_missing.focal_label and exif_unobservable.never_measured passing.
2. exif_crop.focal accuracy (calibration-pending, median focal error 0.279 although views span 120 deg): make the EXIF focal prior robust so the photos can overrule a wrong EXIF when they carry the information: e.g. a two-hypothesis check (solve with the EXIF prior and with a weak prior; adopt the weak-prior solution when its cost improvement is significant at a stated false-alarm rate and the focal is data-observable), or a heavy-tailed prior in log f. Measure on the exif_crop, exif_missing, exif_unobservable and clean rows; must not raise false alarms on clean sets (alarm budget) and must not make the unobservable row worse. If the target (< 5 % when views span >= 60 deg) is still unmet, record the measured level honestly.
3. hair.points_dropped: the 'hair' occluder tag sets the no-silhouette flag but its drop classes ('ear', 'temple') are not resolved to landmarks; map the classes to landmark ids in the landmarks stage exactly as the 'beard' tag does (tr, t_L, t_R, sa_L, sa_R, sba_L, sba_R per the gate), using the scheme's region metadata, not a hard-coded list where the scheme provides one.
4. small_face.q_small: Q-SMALL misses seed 2313 view 3 because face size is max(bbox width, bbox height) of the visible landmarks; DESIGN / com R1.4 say 'face < 250 px wide'. Measure a pose-independent face width (e.g. the inter-landmark scale of a rigid landmark subset compared with the prior's metric size, or the bizygomatic/biocular distance corrected by the view's yaw from the solve) so profile views do not false-alarm; remove the strict xfail when it passes.
5. beauty_warp.tpr: wire the engine's retouch_residual_test into the pipeline after the bundle solve, against the leave-one-view-out consensus (the LOVO solves already exist in observe), emitting Q-RETOUCH with its DESIGN action (exclude from texture; down-weight). Report the measured TPR honestly; the detection power may stay low until FU-04 narrows the noise model, but the wiring and the no-false-alarm honesty gate must hold.
6. off_axis_stereographic.model (optional if time allows): the chosen camera model is recorded and flagged C-MODEL-NOT-APPLIED but not applied; if the solve supports per-view models (solve/camera_model.py), apply the selection for Q-WIDE views and measure the shape cost; otherwise leave the flag and document.
Rules: never weaken a gate or threshold; any new default goes through core.config register_defaults with a source string and badge; regenerate tests/golden/pipeline_small/expected_result.json only if the golden scene's outputs change and say which numbers changed and why; keep the default (non-slow) suite time from growing.

workPackages.title: Narrow the engine noise model with image tangents and recalibrate the single-view detectors (mirror, expression, retouch)
workPackages.spec:
WP-23 (docs/RESULTS.md 3.1 item 6) traced most calibration-pending gates to one cause: the pipeline gives the bundle no image tangents, so every landmark's declared noise is isotropic at max(sigma_n, sigma_t) (FU-01), e.g. the 'free' brow tangent declares 40 mm where the simulator draws 8 mm. Clean-set chi2_red is 0.72 and LOVO gamma 0.86; the single-view detectors never fire through the pipeline (mirror flip 0/30, jaw/smile expressive 0/30, Q-RETOUCH 0/30) and an untagged jaw opening moves the neutral identity 1.06 mm RMS (hard bound 0.3 mm).
Tasks:
1. Image tangents from the detections, never from simulator ground truth: for each view derive the unit image tangent of every curve/contour/extremal landmark from the detected points themselves (chord between the scheme-defined neighbours on the same anatomical curve; extremal points use the local outline direction from their outline neighbours). Add the neighbour/curve metadata to the scheme file if it is missing (anatomical44.json; keep the format backwards compatible; mediapipe_478 only if the same metadata exists). Pass the tangents through reconstruct_landmarks / the pipeline solve (ViewObs(tangents=...)) so the noise is anisotropic (sigma_n along the normal, sigma_t along the tangent). Points without a usable tangent keep the FU-01 isotropic max rule.
2. Re-measure on the WP-01 test bed and the WP-23 fault matrix: clean-set chi2_red and gamma, the honesty bands (DESIGN 7.5: landmark NEES/dof 0.8-1.25 and coverage 0.60-0.76 on the definition-bias row, vertex coverage 0.90-0.99, scale z RMS) and the FU-02 deflation factor; keep every honesty gate passing. Do NOT shrink declared sigmas to match the simulator: the values in DESIGN 4.4 are research priors for real detectors; only the anisotropy (and evidence-backed corrections recorded with a source) may change.
3. Single-view detectors: re-measure mirror (solve/mirror.py), expression re-tag (solve/expression.py + the pipeline re-tag loop) and retouch (wired by FU-03) TPR/FPR with the narrowed model. Then recalibrate their decision thresholds against the engine's own null distribution (pool mirror evidence across views; derive g_min from the decision thresholds, WP-15 note g ~12 for 95 % detection; expression threshold from the chi2 null of the mobile class) at a stated false-alarm rate, keeping the honesty gates (no false flip, no false 'keep' above 0.30, no neutral view tagged expressive, alarm budget) intact. Where a DESIGN 7.4 target is still unreachable at nominal noise, record the measured detection rate and the conditions under which the target holds (WP-15 note), never weaken the gate silently.
4. jaw_open.identity: with better expression detection the untagged jaw should be tagged and its mobile class dropped; if the identity shift still exceeds 0.3 mm, add the robust down-weighting of the mobile class for views whose mobile chi2 is elevated but below the tag threshold, and measure.
5. Run the slow release matrix (python3 -m pytest -q -m slow), update CALIBRATION_PENDING (only remove gates that pass on 30-seed point estimates), regenerate the pipeline golden if its outputs change, and update RESULTS.md (before/after table) and the DESIGN 7.4 status notes.
Rules: new defaults via register_defaults with source and badge; no gate weakened; keep the default suite time from growing.
FU-03 hand-off notes (commit 4ef2749): the post-BA retouch test now uses the declared per-view noise (stages._declared_cov: base / weights x sigma_mult^2); the mirror test in the same loop still uses the base noise and should move to the declared noise as part of task 3. Q-SMALL now uses a pose-independent face width, so more views carry sigma x2 (the clean rear-phone twin has 99 Q-SMALL photos). The focal label is earned from photos-only information (observability.focal_prior_evidence); keep exif_crop.focal_label and exif_crop.no_false_overrule passing. Default suite measured 356 s after FU-03 (WP-23: 345 s); do not grow it further.
